verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships AI features (Amplitude AI, an MCP server, an embedded agent), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no setting or policy that excludes customer data from model training. The SDK consent model and Session Replay masking control what data gets captured, not whether captured data trains AI models, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
